lp.faq.1.a: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML and EPUB. Each document is automatically split, vectorised and indexed for semantic search.
lp.faq.1.q: Which document formats can I upload?
lp.faq.2.a: No. Your documents only ground the answers of your own agents (retrieval-augmented generation), they do not train a model shared with other customers.
lp.faq.2.q: Is my data used to train a third-party model?
lp.faq.3.a: Yes, through an embeddable chat widget (a single script tag) customisable in colours, position and welcome message, or through the public API for a custom integration.
lp.faq.3.q: Can I deploy an agent on my own website?
lp.faq.4.a: An agent answers your questions from your documents. An autonomous agent plans and runs tasks on its own, with tools, memory and guardrails. A workflow chains LLM calls, tools, conditions and human approvals. The evaluation lab then measures answer quality.
lp.faq.4.q: What is the difference between an agent, an autonomous agent and a workflow?
lp.faq.5.a: Yes: multi-tenant organisations, Owner/Admin/Manager/Member/Viewer roles, custom roles with precise permissions, and white-label to offer the platform under your own brand.
lp.faq.5.q: Does the product handle several organisations and roles?
lp.faq.subtitle: Got a question? Here are the essential answers about the platform, the plans and the features.
